ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Otopoly uses the camera to scan the QR code that approves a web sign-in and to add vehicle photos to contracts.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Otopoly accesses your photo library to add the vehicle photos and documents you choose to contracts.
